issue: The A3 Friday entry builder hashed Binance Spot and USD-M exchangeInfo payloads but did not independently enforce the payload serverTime against the already-sealed Thursday signal and Friday entry close. It also relied on the downstream sealer to reject any accidental long/short overlap instead of returning an explicit fail-closed blocker from the builder.
correction: Require serverTime in both Binance payloads. Each server timestamp must be on/after the V16B_SIGNAL_SEAL creation timestamp and strictly before the Friday UTC entry close. Missing, stale or post-close evidence blocks the entry. Any overlap between the sealed longs and first 10 causally shortable names is explicitly BLOCKED before holdings are emitted.
reason_no_new_candidate_id: This amendment only strengthens fail-closed evidence timing and explicit anomaly handling before the first prospective observation; no economic decision rule changes.
